trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy in the game. The platinum drops the moment the 54th trophy pops, there is no extra task. Plan around the one missable trophy first, then clean up in free roam.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission and cannot be missed, just follow the on-screen objectives through the opening sequence.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Keep playing the story and the trophy pops at the chapter's final cutscene. No side content is needed to reach it.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Story progress only, the chapter ends with a set-piece mission and the trophy unlocks right after it.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Push through the main story missions in order and the trophy pops when the chapter closes.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The chapter's last mission is a long one, so stock up on ammo and armor before starting it.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Finish the story and the trophy pops after the ending cutscene. Free roam stays open afterwards for cleanup.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks during the story, play the missions in order and it will appear. Stay close to your partner during the escort stretch.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. It is a story heist with a planning beat first. Pick the loud approach for the fastest clear, then follow the escape route markers.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. A story mission that unlocks mid-game. It has a stealth opening, so move slowly and use cover until the objective updates.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. A story mission that unlocks after the previous chapter beat. The finale is a rooftop chase, so keep a fast car nearby.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. A story airport mission. Follow the waypoint through the terminal, then get the target vehicle out without stopping for the patrols.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. A big story set piece with heavy gunfire. Take the armored option in the approach and use cover between pushes.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100 percent completion. The checklist covers story, stranger missions, activities, collectibles and stunts, and the in-game stats page shows exactly what is left. Finish the story first, then work the list in free roam.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. Stunts count when you catch air, near-miss traffic or land a jump. Bikes and fast cars on the highway ramps rack them up fastest, and the counter ticks in the stats page.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The nine are the arcade, bowling, fishing, shooting range, drone races, street races, darts, pool and the gym minigame. One session in each is enough.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Use a steady aim and short bursts. The pistol and SMG lanes are the easiest golds, so clear those first and save the rifle lanes for last.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Learn each track's shortcut gates, cutting the inside of the ring gates saves seconds. You can retry a location as often as needed.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Street races unlock around the map and each distinct race counts once, so keep moving to new start points instead of replaying one. A tuned car helps on the longer circuits.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at the fishing spots and accept his challenge. Use the heavier line for the big catch and reel steadily when the fish runs.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Any arcade cabinet counts, so pick the shortest game in the arcade and play it to the end screen.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's mission strand unlocks through the story, so finish his jobs in order until the last one appears.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Work through Kenton's boat jobs until the finale unlocks. It ends with a chase on the water, so take the faster boat.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand is bike-focused, so keep a fast motorcycle handy for the final run.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strangers appear as question marks on the map and each strand is several missions, so start them early and finish one before moving on.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's jobs unlock in the story's second half, so finish the strand and the trophy pops after the last delivery.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand ends with a timed drive, so memorize the route on the first attempt and cut the corners on the second.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. THIS IS THE ONLY MISSABLE TROPHY: the spots are only available during Chapter 1, so visit all 18 before finishing the chapter. Meditation spots glow on the map when you are near one, sit and complete the prompt at each.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret marks the hunting ground, so track the animal with the scent trail and take the shot from downwind so it does not bolt.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards hide in shops, houses and mission areas across Leonida, and each set needs every card in it, so check the collection menu to see which cards you still lack.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK It prompt appears at viewpoints and landmarks, so walk up and interact. The map marks visited spots, so sweep region by region.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges cover driving, combat, exploration and activities, and the challenges menu lists them all with progress, so knock out the easy ones first.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Get a 4-star wanted level with your partner in the car, then break line of sight and stay out of the search cones until the stars clear.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Chain three shop robberies without the stars dropping. Plan a route with three close shops and drive, do not stop, between them.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you enter counts, so vary your rides and grab anything unusual you see parked. The vehicle list in the menu tracks what you have found.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus in a crowded firefight and sweep across five targets before the meter runs out. The slowdown makes the shots easier.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Get to the airport, grab a plane and take off without following the flight plan. The trophy pops once you are airborne and clear of the runway.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos. When the tanks roll in, hit them from behind or above with explosives. Sticky bombs on the rear armor work, and the minigun helps once the hatch is open.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in at night, move slowly, take the display cases without tripping the alarms, and leave before the staff turn around.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Each vault is a multi-stage job: crack the vault, grab the cash and lose the cops before the timer ends. Five completed escapes earn the trophy.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks patrol the highways, so ram the rear doors or blow them open, grab the cash and lose the wanted level.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive through every named area, the map fills in as you go, and the stats page counts the areas you have visited. Mop up the last few with a helicopter.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang runs operations around the map, so hit one per gang and the trophy pops after the ninth.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Walk to the Ocean Beach bar at sunset, order the cocktail and watch the view until the prompt completes.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through the showroom's glass front and keep going until you are clear of the building.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt and Associates bowling alley. Play a full game of bowling at the alley, finish all ten frames and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Reach the partnership moment the story builds to. It unlocks through the main story, so keep playing missions.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices. Choices stack up across the whole game: dialogue picks, activity picks and mission decisions all count toward the 500.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail an objective once and then complete it on the retry. The trophy pops on the successful second attempt.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange. Visit the odd spots around Leonida at night, the strange event triggers at a specific location after dark.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by. While driving, swing a melee weapon at a pedestrian and knock them down. It counts on the first clean hit.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder 250,000 dollars of marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from heists, so hand them to your contacts to wash them, and the counter tracks the total washed.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend 100,000 dollars across all shops. Buy cars, clothes, weapons and upgrades, every dollar spent in shops counts toward the total.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are listed on the property site, so buy each one as it appears and the trophy pops on the eighth.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app, photograph a vehicle and register it. Ten different vehicles complete the set.
